requirements.evidence: Seven-series post-access pilot is reported with matched word budgets and an explicit non-confirmatory boundary.
requirements.future_upgrade: A genuinely unseen, prospectively frozen cohort is required only to restore a confirmatory superiority claim.

requirements.evidence: The manuscript explicitly labels model annotations as machine error discovery and disclaims human validation and semantic construct validity.
requirements.future_upgrade: Two independent eligible humans are required only before restoring a validated Structure-Aware claim.

requirements.evidence: AB-0--AB-6, RP factorial, G-U/G-T, Jaccard, series effects, LOSO, runtime, memory, and failures are reported and hash-locked.
requirements.future_upgrade: Repeat on the untouched cohort if the paper is later upgraded to a confirmatory route.

requirements.evidence: The manuscript does not claim improved engineering review time, accuracy, or omission risk.
requirements.future_upgrade: Required only if an operational-effectiveness claim is introduced.

requirements.evidence: The manuscript limits the study to public technical-report proxies and does not generalize to work orders or maintenance records.
requirements.future_upgrade: Required only if maintenance-record generalization is introduced.

requirements.evidence: No humans were recruited and the manuscript reports that boundary; the current study does not present human-subject results.
requirements.future_upgrade: An institutional determination is mandatory before any future human recruitment or annotation.

requirements.evidence: Portable verification, non-mutating checks, LaTeX builds, evidence lock, and release manifest pass.

future_optional_upgrade_requirements: signed author unseen-status and rights attestation
institutional ethics approval, exemption, or formal non-human-subject determination before recruitment
integrity_rule: Future requirements may not be backfilled with synthetic data, model labels, or unsigned assertions.
